import React from 'react'; import devImage from '../devops.avif'; import devresume from '../Dev_Resume.pdf'; const About = () => (

About Me

Hello! I’m Dev Jangir, a DevOps Engineer passionate about building automated, scalable, and secure systems.

Key Skills:

  • DevOps & Automation
  • AWS / Azure Cloud
  • Docker & Kubernetes
  • Terraform & Ansible
  • CI/CD Pipelines
  • Monitoring (Prometheus / Grafana)
  • Bash & Python Scripting
Download Resume
); export default About;
